scene: The opened crate reveals three strange transit tickets.
picture: Along the rooftop ledge, the tall man in a straw hat and red poncho stands centre beside the newly opened wooden crate. On the left waits an idling neon night bus. Up high hangs a glowing ferris wheel gondola attached to an aerial cable. On the right rests a caged book cart lift.
shown: a sleek neon night bus idling at a stop platform on the left
a glowing ferris wheel gondola hanging from a cable up high
a wheeled vertical book cart lift resting on tracks on the right
